summary.business_type: Lodging (B&B / rooms & garden loft) — local brick-and-mortar
top_findings: Canonical + Open Graph point to www.igiardinidirita.it, which currently serves an unrelated adult-content gate page, not this site
Schema is missing sameAs, image, aggregateRating, geo despite the business already having live Booking.com, TripAdvisor, and Facebook profiles with reviews
Hero desktop image is 690KB, unoptimized, and is the LCP element
Bilingual toggle never updates <html lang>, and both language variants sit hidden in the same DOM (no hreflang)
quick_wins: Point canonical/OG to the live Vercel URL
Add a 6-line robots.txt and a 1-URL sitemap.xml
Add sameAs array linking existing Booking/TripAdvisor/Facebook profiles
Add loading="lazy" to the 5 gallery images
Link the existing Facebook page from the footer

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Correct viewport meta, pinch-zoom not disabled
Clean URL, 200 status, CDN cache hit

findings.title: Canonical/OG domain not owned/live
findings.description: canonical, og:url and og:image all reference https://www.igiardinidirita.it/, which currently resolves to an unrelated adult-content landing page (verified live).
findings.recommendation: Point canonical/OG to https://i-giardinidi-rita.vercel.app/ until the real domain is purchased and verified serving this site.

findings.title: robots.txt missing
findings.recommendation: Add a minimal robots.txt with a Sitemap directive.

findings.title: No hreflang / lang not updated on toggle
findings.description: <html lang="it"> never changes when the visitor switches to English via the JS toggle; both language variants exist in the same DOM, one CSS-hidden.
findings.recommendation: Set document.documentElement.lang in the toggle handler; consider real /en/ URL + hreflang if English organic traffic matters.

findings.title: No CSP header
findings.description: Vercel does not set a Content-Security-Policy by default.
findings.recommendation: Optional hardening via vercel.json headers; not required for this static, no-input page.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Original copy, not scraped from Booking.com or Wikipedia
Specific, citable local facts (salt pan size, Ramsar status, IGP onion, real distances)

findings.title: Single page, no depth content
findings.description: One-page brochure site has no supporting pages for longer-tail local queries.
findings.recommendation: Not urgent for launch; consider 1-2 supporting pages later if organic growth beyond OTA/direct traffic matters.

findings.title: Reviews mentioned but not linked
findings.description: "Favoloso 8.8 — 47 recensioni" is plain text, no link to the review source.
findings.recommendation: Link it to the Booking.com listing.

findings.title: Rating discrepancy to verify
findings.description: Live aggregator search shows a 9.1 rating; site shows 8.8.
findings.recommendation: Verify against the live Booking.com extranet figure.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Title 55 chars, safely within display limits
Single h1, sequential h2s, no skipped levels
All images have descriptive alt text

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid LodgingBusiness JSON-LD with name, description, address, telephone, url, priceRange

findings.title: Missing sameAs entity links
findings.description: The business has live, reviewed profiles on Booking.com, TripAdvisor, Facebook, and Bedandbreakfast.eu, none referenced in schema.
findings.recommendation: Add a sameAs array with all four URLs.

findings.title: Missing image, geo, aggregateRating
findings.description: Schema lacks the image, geo coordinates, and aggregateRating properties recommended for LodgingBusiness.
findings.recommendation: Add all three; ratingValue 8.8 / reviewCount 47 already displayed in the UI.

categories.name: Performance
what_works: Hero video correctly gated to mobile-only via matchMedia, never fetched on desktop

findings.title: Unoptimized hero image
findings.description: assets/esterno.jpg is 690KB with no compression or next-gen format; it is the desktop LCP element.
findings.recommendation: Compress + convert to WebP, target under 150KB.

findings.title: No responsive images
findings.description: Every photo ships one fixed resolution regardless of device.
findings.recommendation: Add srcset/sizes or a smaller mobile copy.

findings.title: No explicit image dimensions
findings.description: Minor CLS risk while images decode.

categories.name: Images
what_works: 7/7 images have descriptive, non-generic alt text

findings.title: No next-gen formats or size optimization
findings.recommendation: Convert to WebP/AVIF with fallback, compress.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Specific, extractable facts in body copy (salt pan size, Ramsar status, IGP onion)

findings.title: No sameAs entity graph
findings.description: Same finding as Schema section — this is the top GEO lever available.

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.description: Not a formal standard yet, but some AI crawlers respect it.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Fix canonical/OG domain to the live Vercel URL
Add sameAs array to schema (Booking, TripAdvisor, Facebook, Bedandbreakfast.eu)

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Compress and convert hero image to WebP
Link existing Facebook page from footer
Sync <html lang> with the IT/EN toggle

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Verify live Booking.com rating matches on-site figure
Consider supporting pages for long-tail local queries
Add responsive srcset to gallery photos

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Submit domain + sitemap to Google Search Console once the real domain is live
Re-check site: indexing after Phase 1 ships
Re-check "B&B Margherita di Savoia" ranking monthly against the named competitors found this session
